<image>
What is the person doing with the white t-shirt on the table?

A person's hands are positioned over a white t-shirt lying flat on a large white table. The left hand is placed on the upper right side of the shirt's chest area, while the right hand is near the bottom right corner, appearing to adjust or fold the fabric. To the left of the shirt, there is a pile of crumpled white fabric. To the right, a neat stack of folded white t-shirts is visible. A small blue tool and a pink cylindrical object rest on the table near the stack of shirts.

<image>
What is the person doing with the white fabric on the table?

A person wearing a dark long-sleeved shirt is standing behind a white table. Their right hand is holding the top corner of a large piece of white fabric, while their left hand is positioned near the bottom edge of the fabric. To the left of the person, there is a large pile of crumpled white fabric on the table. A black smartphone and a small cylindrical container are placed on the table surface between the pile and the person. To the right of the person, there is a neat stack of folded white fabric. In the background, shelves holding more white fabric are visible.
